items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I think Duke Ellington was in town with his band also, and Ray Nance was there, I remember, this particular session.

ctx.x: When you played with him at this session the first time you got a chance to play with him, do you remember who some of the other guys were who played at that particular session?

Well, it's hard to say. I'm sure that Art Tatum was there. And at this one our guitarist, Everett Barksdale, he was on the scene, and I think Duke Ellington was in town with his band also, and Ray Nance was there, I remember, this particular session. And if I'm not mistaken Jimmy Blanton came in.
Oh, well, this was -- this was quite -- this was quite a session, yeah.
